channel.title: Yizhou Yu · Writing
channel.description: Essays on working with AI agents.

item.title: Claude Code Edits My Travel Vlogs Now
item.description: For my last dozen-plus travel vlogs I never opened a video editor. Here is the workflow, what I still do, and why the cuts keep getting more like me.

item.title: I Deleted the UI and Just Talked to the Agent
item.description: I rebuilt my YouTube publishing tool from a Flask web app into a conversation with an agent in the terminal. The interface between a human and an AI doesn't have to be a UI — and once it wasn't boxed into my forms, it started doing things no screen of mine could.

item.title: 养成系 — The Mindset Shift To Make When Working With AI
item.description: Your AI agent isn't a product that works out of the box — it's a partner that compounds with every interaction. Every correction is compound interest.

item.title: I Shipped Three Projects in 48 Hours Using Claude Code (And Wrote Zero Line of Code)
item.description: How I built a YouTube Manager, personal website, and Life in Weeks visualization in one weekend using Claude Code — 137 commits, zero lines of code written by hand.
